purpose: Quantify movement in the completed cold-start arms, then create one deliberately incomplete exploration warm start shared by every Stage C2 credit arm.

separation_of_factors.exploration_component: A single SFT checkpoint selected only by planted-action support, before consulting any held-out reward.
separation_of_factors.credit_component: Not varied in this protocol. The selected merged checkpoint will become the identical initialization for broadcast, full-suffix, and sliced arms in a separately frozen campaign.
separation_of_factors.claim_boundary: This protocol can clear an exploration-support prerequisite. It cannot establish a ReDCO learning advantage.

policy_audit.cases: Eight exact rendered gamma-route prefixes recovered from observed Stage C training tensors, one per finite probe.
policy_audit.action_tokens: Observed one-token digit IDs 15 through 22; no retokenized prompt is used.
measurements: full-vocabulary action probabilities at temperatures 1.0 and 2.0
full-vocabulary KL from base at temperature 1.0
allowed-action KL from base at temperature 1.0
policy_audit.limitation: Every observed root context used route gamma. Generalization of support to other route strings is not asserted by this audit.

dataset.scope: The dataset raises support for the missing useful action and does not teach the other seven probe solutions.

selection_rule.selected_checkpoint: the earliest checkpoint meeting every bound
selection_rule.failure: If no one of the 12 checkpoints meets every bound, report the warm-start prerequisite as failed and do not launch a learning arm.

merge_gate.method: PEFT safe_merge into a temporary local copy of the same 4B base
merge_gate.retention: Keep the selected LoRA adapter and signed merge manifest locally. The reproducible merged 4B model remains ephemeral and is not copied to the local workspace.

execution_policy.pre_model_setup_failures: May be corrected only if logs establish that neither scoring nor an optimizer step occurred.
execution_policy.gpu_protocol: Use at most one non-spot 2x48GB non-A100/non-H100 pod at no more than $2.00/hour, selected in a hardware-only amendment.
execution_policy.reuse_one_pod_for_followup: If the warm-start gate passes, keep the same ephemeral pod only long enough to freeze and execute the authorized Stage C2 campaign, avoiding a second dependency/model download.
execution_policy.artifact_policy: Sync raw scores, logs, metrics, all manifests, the gate report, and only the selected adapter. Do not retain unselected adapters or the merged 4B model locally.
